description: Repairs r-def-expr-sql/sql-querydef-names: the early name 'q ' collided with the later names. Asks whether Database.CreateQueryDef accepts 'q ' (trailing space) and then 'q' on a fresh copy with no other QueryDef, what Name reads for each, and whether each opens by that name; QueryDefs is refreshed before Count and the names are read. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
